name: Underdog Sports Holdings, Inc.
note: US daily fantasy sports and prediction markets company led by co-founders Jeremy Levine (Chief Executive Officer) and Brandon Stakenborg (Chief Product Officer) (IG Group acquisition RNS, 30 July 2026); its shareholders are not publicly identified. London-listed IG Group Holdings plc announced on 30 July 2026 that it had agreed to acquire the company for up to approximately $1.3 billion, subject to US regulatory approvals and HSR clearance, and said on 8 September 2026 the deal remained subject to regulatory approvals (iggroup.com).
